samuel1.11.p1.b1.text: Soon Nahash the Ammonite came up and laid siege to Jabesh-gilead.

samuel1.11.p1.b2.text: Make a treaty with us, and we will serve you.

samuel1.11.p1.b3.text: I will make a treaty with you on one condition, that I may put out everyone’s right eye and bring reproach upon all Israel.

samuel1.11.p1.b4.text: Hold off for seven days … let us send messengers throughout Israel. If there is no one to save us, we will surrender to you.

samuel1.11.p2.b1.text: When the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul and relayed these words in the hearing of the people, they all wept aloud.

samuel1.11.p2.b2.text: Just then Saul was returning from the field, behind his oxen.

samuel1.11.p2.b3.text: What troubles the people? … Why are they weeping?

samuel1.11.p2.b4.text: When Saul heard their words, the Spirit of God rushed upon him, and he burned with great anger.

samuel1.11.p3.b1.text: He took a pair of oxen, cut them into pieces, and sent them by messengers throughout the land of Israel, proclaiming

samuel1.11.p3.b2.text: This is what will be done to the oxen of anyone who does not march behind Saul and Samuel.

samuel1.11.p3.b3.text: Then the terror of the LORD fell upon the people, and they turned out as one man.

samuel1.11.p3.b4.text: And when Saul numbered them at Bezek, there were 300,000 Israelites and 30,000 men of Judah.

samuel1.11.p4.b1.text: Tell the men of Jabesh-gilead … Deliverance will be yours tomorrow by the time the sun is hot.

samuel1.11.p4.b2.text: And when the messengers relayed this to the men of Jabesh, they rejoiced.

samuel1.11.p4.b3.text: Tomorrow we will come out, and you can do with us whatever seems good to you.

samuel1.11.p5.b1.text: The next day Saul organized the troops into three divisions, and during the morning watch they invaded the camp of the Ammonites …

samuel1.11.p5.b2.text: … And the survivors were so scattered that no two of them were left together.

samuel1.11.p6.b1.text: Who said that Saul should not reign over us? Bring those men here so we can kill them!

samuel1.11.p6.b2.text: No one shall be put to death this day, for today the LORD has worked salvation in Israel.

samuel1.11.p6.b3.text: Come, let us go to Gilgal and renew the kingship there.

samuel1.11.p6.b4.text: So all the people went to Gilgal and confirmed Saul as king in the presence of the LORD. … and Saul and all the Israelites rejoiced greatly.
